claims.statement: The implemented scalar, O(2) matter and metric field equations (diagonal and t-x off-diagonal components) of the UET parent code follow from the Theory Card action UET-PARENT-ACTION-001.
claims.note: Mathematical consistency only; says nothing about whether nature follows this action.

claims.statement: epsilon is not an independent coupling of the parent action: in canonical variables xi_c and m_psi are epsilon-independent, lambda_psi ~ 1/epsilon and g_c ~ sqrt(epsilon), so epsilon = 0 is a degenerate point rather than a continuous GR limit.

Assuming ordinary matter couples minimally to the Jordan metric, the UET parent action maps onto the Damour-Esposito-Farese class with alpha0 = 0 and beta0 = -2 xi_c around psi0 = 0, so PPN gamma - 1 = 0 at that background.
claims.note: Mathematical mapping only; confrontation with binary-pulsar data is W6 (Test Card T001).

claims.statement: Binary-pulsar timing (ZFKSW22) excludes the UET non-minimal coupling interval that maps to the analysed DEF scalarization range, for a scalar light compared with the binary orbits; the parent action stays compatible for other xi_c.
claims.note: CONSTRAINT (not a prediction): xi_c in [2.0, 2.4] excluded for m_psi <= 2.5e-18 eV; L2 promotion approved by the author 2026-11-09.

claims.statement: In the layer-3 model, systems that disappear when their free-energy store F is exhausted at burn power P give steady abundance N* = b F/P (Little's law), replicator dynamics with fitness aR - P/F as an identity, and selection of the lowest R* = P/(a F) under a shared resource, without imposed payoffs.
claims.note: Mathematical consistency of the author's persistence-selection logic; no empirical confrontation yet.

claims.statement: The layer-3 abundance law N = b F/P, with stellar-model lifetimes and independently measured helium, predicts the horizontal-to-red-giant-branch star ratio in old globular clusters to within about 5 percent (R_pred = 1.467 +/- 0.023 vs R_obs = 1.39 +/- 0.03), a 2.05 sigma tension.
claims.note: CONSTRAINT, outcome INCONCLUSIVE by the preregistered rule (2 < z <= 3). Not a falsification and not a pass. L2 recording approved by the author 2026-11-09.

claims.statement: In the parent action, matter (the O(2) field) exchanges energy-momentum only with the response field, at the derived rate d^mu T_mu_nu = (1/2) eps h |chi|^2 d_nu phi on the matter shell; with h = 0 matter is separately conserved.
claims.note: Supports author point 2 mathematically. Calling the response field 'structure of space' is an interpretation.

claims.statement: The canonical UET potential has a true vacuum with psi0 != 0 when chi condenses (m2_chi < 0), and can have one with all masses positive when lam_chi is small (explicit example); then alpha0 != 0 and gamma_PPN != 1. A sufficient condition for psi0 = 0 is m2_chi > 0 and g_c^2 <= 2 lam_chi m2_psi.
claims.note: A falsification route for a future Test Card (Cassini); not yet confronted with data.
